officialLinks.label: Undergraduate grade values; pass/fail; repeats; Dean’s List; honors

helpIntro: Wake Forest undergraduate GPA uses a 4.00 credit-hour-weighted scale with plus/minus grades. Enter Wake Forest graded courses to estimate current, projected, and target GPA.
helpNote: For Wake Forest College and the undergraduate School of Business. Pass/fail and transfer grades are excluded. Ordinary eligible repeats use the highest grade; irreplaceable honor-code F cases require manual review.
helpExample: A 3-credit A- earns 11.01 grade points and a 3-credit B+ earns 9.99; together, 21.00 ÷ 6 = 3.500.

gradeExplanations.A: A = 4.00 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.A-: A- = 3.67 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.B+: B+ = 3.33 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.B: B = 3.00 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.B-: B- = 2.67 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.C+: C+ = 2.33 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.C: C = 2.00 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.C-: C- = 1.67 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.D+: D+ = 1.33 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.D: D = 1.00 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.D-: D- = 0.67 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.F: Standard graded F = 0.00; hours count in GPA. Pass/fail failures are handled with the Pass/fail course type.
gradeExplanations.I: Incomplete has no GPA impact while unresolved; it can later become F if not completed by the deadline.
gradeExplanations.NR: Not Reported has no GPA impact while unresolved; it can later become F if not resolved by the deadline.

specialTypes.name: Wake Forest course, standard grading
specialTypes.note: Use for ordinary undergraduate letter-graded Wake Forest courses.

specialTypes.name: Wake Forest pass/fail course
specialTypes.note: Pass/fail courses are excluded from GPA whether passed or failed.

specialTypes.name: External transfer credit
specialTypes.note: Accepted transfer credit can count toward degree hours, but transfer grades do not enter the Wake Forest GPA.

specialTypes.name: Irreplaceable honor-code F / repeat
specialTypes.note: An irreplaceable F remains in the cumulative GPA even after a repeat; use official records/advising for this exception.

repeatPolicy.note: For an eligible ordinary repeat, the calculator estimates the GPA using the higher of the original and repeat grades. Do not use Repeat Impact for an irreplaceable honor-code F.
